name: Canh chua ca loc
summary: A sour-sweet field-snakehead soup, common across the South, with fish sauce and sliced chili, eaten with a bowl of white rice.
taste: It tastes sour-sweet, lifted by fish sauce and sliced chili.
howToEat: Eat it with a bowl of white rice at the end of the day.
seoTitle: Canh chua ca loc — sour snakehead soup
seoDescription: Canh chua cá lóc, the sour-sweet southern snakehead soup with fish sauce and chili, eaten with white rice.
